payload.claim: The docstring cites '(item 145)' as the source of the rule that `check` must judge the same rows `history` prints, but `docs/backlog/145-spec-reviewer-check-4-does-not-know-the-ceilings-line-exists.md` is a closed, unrelated item about the spec-reviewer prompt reading the rendered `ceilings:` line instead of redoing the comparison by eye — it says nothing about row selection parity between two commands. The rule this comment documents actually comes from this task's own item (b-281f0a) and criterion 2. No gate checks citation accuracy in code comments, so a future reader tracing this rule to item 145 will find it already closed on a different concern and be misled about where the requirement comes from.
